changeSet.sql: UPDATE documents d SET content_hash = encode(digest(s.content, 'sha256'), 'hex') FROM document_sources s WHERE s.document_id = d.id AND d.content_hash IS NULL

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, content_hash FROM documents WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND content_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, content_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates
